intent.purpose: Receive a concise selection from the sources I choose.
intent.success: A short overview of substantive items relevant to my confirmed interests.

interests.focus: Replace with an interest confirmed by the user.

procedure.navigation: Replace with instructions for reaching the chosen source and surfaces using observed navigation.
procedure.account_identity: Establish the signed-in identity from account UI and use a stable account key scoped to this service.
procedure.read_state: Inspect previews unless opening an item is known to preserve its read state. Describe any source-specific acknowledgement effects before use.
procedure.item_identity: Use observed stable item IDs or canonical links and the original inspected text with the shared fingerprint helper.
procedure.pagination: Use observed next-page or load-more controls. Describe how this source signals exhaustion; treat ordering as unknown until verified.

selection.include: Items that meet the user’s confirmed interests or explicitly requested categories. Give a concrete reason for inclusion.
selection.uncertain_relevance: Omit weak matches; do not fill the allowance.
selection.evidence: Summarize only inspected content, label truncated previews and distinguish source claims from verified facts.

coverage_threads.on_access_failure: Report the unavailable surface; do not fall back to another browser or access route.

test: Substantive, clearly outside the listed interests, with a concrete reason to deserve attention.
